name: Philetus
title: False Teaching in the Church
summary: Philetus was a person in the early church who, together with Hymeneus, spread false doctrine. They claimed that the resurrection had already taken place, and through this error they undermined the faith of some in the church.

keyEvents.title: Spreading False Doctrine
keyEvents.description: Philetus and Hymeneus spread false teaching by claiming that the resurrection had already occurred, which undermined the Christian hope of a future resurrection.

keyEvents.title: Undermining Faith
keyEvents.description: Paul warned Timothy that the teaching of Philetus and Hymeneus was spreading like gangrene and was overturning the faith of some believers.
